_comment: ExtraRLHF MCP server registration. The server is stdio JSON-RPC 2.0 (python3 -m rlhf_env.mcp_server). It MUST run from the repo root so the `rlhf_env` package + relative paths (ai/models, ai/cards.json) resolve. Replace <REPO_ROOT> with the absolute path to your ExtraArenaRaS checkout. CLI flags can also be set via env vars: RLHF_MODELS_DIR, RLHF_SESSIONS_DIR, RLHF_CARDS_PATH, RLHF_LOG_LEVEL.
